Internal view computing total earned rewards for an account in an epoch.

Miner-influenced timestamp used for epoch timing and reward rates.

External ERC20 safeTransfer call sending reward tokens in getReward.

edges.reason: initialize flips the initialized flag; no access control prevents a front-run initialization.
rewardsToken is assigned from the _rewardsToken parameter.
stakingToken is assigned from the _stakingToken parameter.
rewardsDistributor is assigned from the _rewardsDistributor parameter.
externalController is assigned from the _externalController parameter.
fixPool gates execution on msg.sender matching a hardcoded address.
fixPool derives rewardsDuration and epoch timestamps from block.timestamp.
recalcRate parameter branches the rate recalculation in fixPool.
accounts parameter drives the reward reset loop in fixPool.
fixPool calls _updateRewardForEpoch to refresh epoch checkpoints.
fixPool rewrites rewardRate, timestamps and rewardPerTokenStored in epochData.
amount parameter flows into _stake accounting and transfer.
_stake increases epochData totalSupply.
_stake increases the caller balance in _balances.
_stake writes lastAccountEpoch for the caller.
_stake reads currentEpochId to select the epoch to stake into.
_stake uses msg.sender for balance, epoch and transfer accounting.
_stake performs an external safeTransferFrom when withDepositTransfer is true.
safeTransferFrom gives control to the staking token, which can reenter _stake state updates.
stake delegates to the internal _stake logic.
updateReward modifier refreshes rewards before stake executes.
stakeWithPermit delegates to the internal _stake logic.
stakeWithPermit performs an external permit call before staking.
permit is an external call to an arbitrary staking token that could reenter.
updateReward modifier runs before stakeWithPermit body.
deadline parameter is forwarded to the permit call.
v signature component is forwarded to the permit call.
r signature component is forwarded to the permit call.
s signature component is forwarded to the permit call.
amount parameter flows into withdraw accounting and transfer.
withdraw uses msg.sender for epoch lookup, balances and transfer recipient.
withdraw reads lastAccountEpoch to select the epoch of the caller.
withdraw decreases totalSupply of the caller's last epoch.
withdraw decreases the caller balance in _balances.
local lastEpoch caches the caller epoch used for accounting in withdraw.
withdraw sends staking tokens via safeTransfer.
safeTransfer hands control to the staking token which may reenter withdraw.
updateReward modifier runs before withdraw body.
getReward transfers reward tokens via safeTransfer.
safeTransfer hands control to the reward token which may reenter getReward.
getReward reads and zeroes the caller reward entry.
local reward caches the claimable amount in getReward.
updateReward modifier runs before getReward body.
exit invokes withdraw with the caller's full balance.
exit invokes getReward after withdrawing.
exit reads and resets lastAccountEpoch for the caller.
exit reads _balances for the caller's epoch to determine the withdraw amount.
updateStakingEpoch refreshes the previous epoch rewards first.
updateStakingEpoch re-stakes the migrated amount through _stake.
updateStakingEpoch moves balances between _balances epochs.
updateStakingEpoch updates lastAccountEpoch to the current epoch.
updateStakingEpoch migrates reward entries between epochs.
updateStakingEpoch reduces the previous epoch totalSupply.
updateStakingEpoch compares lastAccountEpoch with currentEpochId.
local stakedAmount carries the migrated balance in updateStakingEpoch.
_updateRewardForEpoch writes rewardPerTokenStored and lastUpdateTime.
_updateRewardForEpoch writes accrued rewards for the account.
_updateRewardForEpoch writes userRewardPerTokenPaid for the account.
_updateRewardForEpoch calls _rewardPerToken to compute the stored rate.
_updateRewardForEpoch calls _earned to compute the account reward.
_updateRewardForEpoch calls _lastTimeRewardApplicable to set lastUpdateTime.
notifyRewardAmount requires msg.sender to equal rewardsDistributor.
notifyRewardAmount validates startEpoch against block.timestamp.
reward parameter determines the new epoch reward rate.
startEpoch parameter is stored in the new epoch struct.
finishEpoch parameter is stored in the new epoch struct.
notifyRewardAmount writes the new epoch into epochData.
notifyRewardAmount increments currentEpochId.
local rewardsDuration divides the reward to obtain rewardRate.
local newEpoch struct is populated and stored in epochData.
externalWithdraw requires msg.sender to equal externalController.
externalWithdraw performs an external rewardsToken transfer to the caller.
The unprotected rewardsToken transfer allows the recipient to reenter externalWithdraw.
externalWithdraw reads rewardsToken balance and transfers it out.
_rewardPerToken calls _lastTimeRewardApplicable for rate accrual.
_rewardPerToken reads epoch struct fields from epochData.
_lastTimeRewardApplicable compares block.timestamp against epoch bounds.
_lastTimeRewardApplicable reads startEpoch and finishEpoch from epochData.
_earned uses the account balance from _balances.
_earned calls _rewardPerToken to compute the delta.
_earned adds the stored reward entry from rewards.
_earned subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid from the current rate.
updateReward modifier calls _updateRewardForEpoch before applying the body.
updateReward modifier reads lastAccountEpoch to resolve the effective epoch.
local lastEpoch resolves the effective epoch inside the modifier.
_totalSupply reads totalSupply from epochData.
_balanceOf reads the account balance from _balances.

Initializer-only parameter that flows directly into the rewardsToken state variable.

Loop input consumed only by fixPool.

Epoch start input consumed only by notifyRewardAmount.
Epoch finish input consumed only by notifyRewardAmount.
Withdrawal amount consumed only by withdraw.
Stake amount consumed only by stake and forwarded to _stake.
Permit deadline consumed only by stakeWithPermit.
Signature component consumed only by stakeWithPermit.
Signature component consumed only by stakeWithPermit.
Signature component consumed only by stakeWithPermit.
Epoch snapshot local used only within fixPool.
Duration divisor local used to compute rewardRate in notifyRewardAmount.
Epoch struct local assembled and stored by notifyRewardAmount.
Cached epoch local used for accounting inside withdraw.
Cached claimable amount local used inside getReward.
Migrated balance local used inside updateStakingEpoch.
Effective epoch local resolved inside the updateReward modifier.
